scope: Pre-refinement quality assessment for technical tasks. This is not a Definition of Done.

scoring.note: Criteria with implemented=false carry no points and do not affect score or ready gate.

assessmentRules.readyGate: A task cannot be 'Ready' if any required criterion is 'flag' or 'not-assessable'.

criteria.description: Describes the technical work in concrete steps or bullet points.
criteria.passCondition: At least two concrete work items or steps are described.

criteria.description: Explains why this task is needed (e.g., EOL, security, performance, tech debt).
criteria.passCondition: A clear trigger or rationale is stated; the model must not invent justification.

criteria.description: Identifies affected systems, expected downtime, and involved teams.
criteria.passCondition: Affected systems or services are named; downtime is stated or explicitly flagged as unknown.

criteria.description: Provides a rollback or remediation plan.
criteria.passCondition: A rollback approach is described or the lack of a rollback is explicitly justified with mitigations.

criteria.description: Contains acceptance criteria or verification steps.
criteria.passCondition: At least one testable outcome or verification step is present.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria or verification steps are observable and testable.
criteria.passCondition: Each criterion has a verifiable outcome; vague terms are defined or flagged.

criteria.description: Flags signs that the task is likely too broad for a single sprint.
criteria.passCondition: No broadness indicators are present, or any conclusion explicitly remains a risk signal.
indicators: Multiple independent technical initiatives combined with 'and'
Words such as 'all', 'complete', 'entire' without narrow boundary
No clear verification or rollback path

criteria.description: The technical approach is feasible and well-understood.
criteria.passCondition: The model judges the approach feasible with identified dependencies and risks; significant technical uncertainty fails.

criteria.description: The rollback plan is adequate for the production impact.
criteria.passCondition: Rollback is tested or adequately described for the impact; an untested or inadequate rollback fails.

criteria.description: Names the affected system, component, or service and the technical domain.
criteria.passCondition: System/component and technical domain are explicitly stated.

criteria.description: Documents dependencies on other teams, services, or external factors.
criteria.passCondition: Dependencies are named or explicitly flagged as unknown.

examples.title: Database migration to PostgreSQL 16
examples.summary: Clear technical scope, justification (EOL), impact analysis, rollback plan, and testable verification steps.

examples.title: Update the database
examples.body: We should update the database soon.

examples.title: Modernize infrastructure
examples.body: Migrate all services to Kubernetes, update all databases, and implement service mesh.
examples.expectedObservation: Multiple independent initiatives; recommend splitting by service or domain.
